note: GENERATED by `pnpm ds:manifest` from source. Do not edit. The contract block is projected from design-system/contract.json.

variant.meaning: visual weight / emphasis. `inline` and `trigger` are presentation modes (as opposed to weight) used by pickers with more than one interaction shape — e.g. PeoplePicker's pill-and-search vs. combobox-button-and-popover. `joined`/`split` are SegmentedControl's container treatment: one shared bordered pill with no gaps between segments, vs. each segment as its own bordered button with a gap — used when a multi-tone answer control (Yes/Partly/No/Not sure) needs each choice to read as a standalone decision rather than one rung of a single switch.

size.meaning: scale. `none` means the property this scales is switched off entirely (a Card with no padding, so a table can meet its edges) — it is not a synonym for `xs`.

tone.meaning: semantic intent. Two families, and mixing them up is the mistake to watch for. SEMANTIC: brand, accent, success, warning, danger, info — what the thing MEANS. `accent` is the lime highlight: deliberate emphasis only, never a second primary. EMPHASIS: neutral (default weight), muted, subtle, strong, inverse (on a dark surface), current (inherit the surrounding colour) — how loud the thing is when it means nothing in particular. There is no `default`: `neutral` is the default, and having both would be one concept with two names.

onValueChange.meaning: semantic change, passes value not event

shape.meaning: outline of a container whose silhouette is meaningful (avatar, icon button). NOT visual weight — that is `variant`.

orientation.meaning: layout axis. Resolves logically, so `horizontal` follows `dir`.

isSelected.meaning: controlled on/off for a two-state control (switch, chip, checkbox)

messages.meaning: translatable copy. Defaults are English; the prop is what makes the component localisable at all.

bannedPropNotes.type: Legal ONLY as a native DOM attribute passthrough (input/button type). Never for visual style — use `variant`.
bannedPropNotes.disabled: Use `isDisabled`. Native `disabled` still reaches the DOM element via prop spreading.

tierRules.atoms: No other components. No app state. No data fetching. No external margins.
tierRules.molecules: Composes atoms only. Local UI state allowed. No data fetching.
tierRules.organisms: Composes molecules/atoms. May consume context. Receives data, does not fetch (unless RSC).
tierRules.templates: Layout and ReactNode slots only. Zero business logic.
tierRules.pages: src/app only. The only tier that fetches data or knows about routing.

forbidden: Tailwind arbitrary values e.g. text-[#fff] or p-[13px]
valueRules.required: All visual values resolve through semantic tokens in design-system/tokens/semantic.css
